summary: OKYO Pharma Ltd filed a Form 6-K to announce its CEO and CSO presentations at upcoming scientific conferences (Eyecelerator and ARVO Annual Meeting). The filing contains no transaction, no acquisition or divestiture, no shareholder vote, and no change in control. It is purely an investor-relations update regarding conference participation and a pipeline update on urcosimod. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no special-situation mechanics. This is a routine foreign private issuer report on Form 6-K furnished under Rule 13a-16, not a special situation.
